road_type: Elevated Bridge Lower Urban Main Road

evaluation.justice: Multi-lane standard layout, balanced motor and non-motor traffic organization, good accessibility.
evaluation.safety: Wide lanes, clear traffic markings, good sight distance, mature traffic safety management.
evaluation.livability: Under viaduct, shaded and noisy, low surrounding residential livability.
evaluation.sustainability: Side green belts for basic ecological maintenance, overall ecological benefit limited.
evaluation.aesthetics: Neat municipal road under large viaduct structure, functional but lack of landscape aesthetics.
evaluation.comfort: Blocked sunlight under the bridge, noise and damp affect travel comfort.
evaluation.walkability: Sidewalk reserved, but under-bridge environment reduces walking experience.
evaluation.bikeability: Wide lane space, suitable for normal commuting cycling.
